description: This file defines functions, classes, and context managers for managing backends used in scaled dot product attention within torch.nn.functional, including warning controls, backend selection, and registration of attention implementations.

classes.name: SDPBackend
classes.description: Enum-like class representing different backends for scaled dot product attention, used with the sdpa_kernel context manager.

methods.name: _raise_kernel_warnings
methods.description: Raises warnings if fused kernels cannot be used, based on the WARN_FOR_UNFUSED_KERNELS flag.

methods.name: _backend_from_string
methods.description: Returns the backend enum member corresponding to a string name.

methods.name: _cur_sdpa_kernel_backends
methods.description: Returns the current enabled backends for scaled dot product attention, optionally sorted by priority.

methods.name: _sdpa_kernel
methods.description: Sets the active backends for scaled dot product attention based on provided list.

methods.name: sdpa_kernel
methods.description: Context manager to temporarily set backends for scaled dot product attention, restoring previous state after exit.

methods.name: _sdpa_kernel_variadic
methods.description: Variadic version of sdpa_kernel for use with multiple backends.

methods.name: _get_flash_version
methods.description: Returns the version string for the flash attention backend.
